rootCause: Authored intake forwarded browser-ignored HTML void-element end tags unchanged into renderer_isolation._PolicyParser, whose intentionally strict balance check rejects every void end tag. The generic RendererPolicyError retry correction also omitted this exact cause, so the recovery prompt was blind.

fix.layer: authored HTML normalization before renderer isolation
fix.scope: Only end-tag tokens for the HTML-spec void-element set are deleted; non-void end tags remain unchanged and fail closed when unbalanced.
